summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K reporting the second tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme announced on 6 May 2026 and running from 19 May to no later than 20 July 2026. During 8–12 June 2026, it purchased 414,792 own shares at an average NOK 353.25 per share, bringing the tranche total to 1,469,068 shares at an average NOK 353.76. Post-transaction, Equinor holds 66.5 million treasury shares (2.60% of capital). The buy-back is conducted under EU Market Abuse Regulation and Norwegian law. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine capital return program — an issuer repurchasing its own shares in the open market.
